messages: Aisha (CSM): FYI — Aethera onboarding: 95th perc chat latency spikes at peak hours. Our SLO is 200ms; observed 360-420ms on /chat/respond. Token cost also crept up ~30% WoW.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Oof. Any traces or token/seq distribution we can inspect? KV cache hit rate?
Aisha (CSM): Pushed metrics snapshot to the console: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/aethera/metrics
Aisha (CSM): Median seq length ~480, but ~6% of requests are long (>3k) from document-attached transcripts. KV hits ~69% — room to improve with prefix caching for repetitive intents.

Liam (Solutions Eng): Proposal:
1) Canary an int8-quantized compact model on 3% of traffic limited to non-critical intents.
2) Route background/async tasks (summaries, batch analytics) to a cheaper model pool.
3) Enable prefix/KV caching for top 12 intents, TTL 4h.
4) Throttle max_new_tokens for interactive chat route to 128 when user is not in live session.
Rory (Aethera-Dev): We can greenlight a short canary window today 15:00-17:00 PST. We can't alter user prompts; long contexts come from file uploads.

Noah (Product): We'll need an eval plan pre/post canary. Suggest: 250 sampled requests stratified by intent, automated similarity checks on embeddings, plus 12 manual reviews. Quality gate: <=2.5% drop in top-intent accuracy.
Jules (Success Ops): Adding a renewal risk note — NPS dipped in last CS touch. Flagging for renewal ops and tying outcome to canary results. @Marcus (Renewals) please add to watchlist.

Liam (Solutions Eng): Sample routing policy I can apply during window:
```
route_policy:
  match_paths: ["/chat/respond","/chat/stream"]
  branch:
    - model: redwood-compact-int8-v2
      pct: 3
      criteria: {"intent_priority": ["low","background"]}
    - model: redwood-standard-v1
      pct: 97
```
With prefix cache on top intents I expect 20-35% latency reduction on cacheable calls. Cost saving on the canary slice ~15% tokens.
Aisha (CSM): Can we implement a rollback trigger? If intent accuracy drop >2.5% OR error-rate >1% in the window, auto-rollback.
DeployBot: Canary scheduled: deploy-2026-6888888888-c1 — start 2026-03-23T22:00:00Z. Auto-rollback configured on quality/error thresholds.
Rory (Aethera-Dev): Confirmed. We'll keep analytics collection disabled for the canary cohort and share top-12 intents by EOD.
Jules (Success Ops): I'll log the CRM activity and create a renewal risk card. Also scheduling a short enablement sync with Aethera tomorrow 08:00 PST to set expectations.
Noah (Product): I'll own the evaluation pipeline and share results dashboard within 2 hours of canary end. If we see regressions, we'll revert and collect diffs to inform next step.

Aisha (CSM): Thanks all. Action items: Liam deploys routing + cache config, DeployBot runs canary, Noah runs evals, Rory delivers intent list, Jules logs CRM + renewal watch. Please post quick status updates here during the window. :thumbsup:
